correctness.rationale:
The self-contained proof explicitly derives Der(L), establishes the exterior-square tangent-preserver lemma over arbitrary \(\operatorname{char}K
e2\) using \(n\ge4\) coefficient comparisons and four-point relations, then constructs a genuine derivation for every input vector. The independence and uniqueness of P,Q,A imply exactly the cardinality and dimension formulas. The extracted package verifier checks full tangent systems for \(p=3,5\) in rank four and \(p=3\) in rank five, with no extrapolation from finite tests.

value.rationale: A complete description of all linear local derivations of a natural arbitrary-rank family solves a motivated local-to-global question; the \(n^2\)-dimensional defect and explicit q-populations do not follow from prior existence or Lie-closure theorems. The exterior-square lemma explains the exact rigidity mechanism. The known rank-three calculations are excluded.
